digest.component_or_area: src/rebar comment reorganization across six subsystems
propositions: ~2,033 lines of recoverable comments identified across 439 files in src/rebar, with per-shard allocation prioritizing reconciler (~970 lines), plan_review/workflow (~230), store/reducer (~230), llm core (~218), commands/CLI (~205), and root/services (~180).

Self-referential prose explaining the 800-line module cap occupies 28 sites in reconciler and closes at outbound_differ.py:164, blocking genuine optimization by consuming headroom with its own justification.

Three modules (event_append.py, _processors.py, signing.py) cannot be relocated because their comments encode load-bearing replay-compatibility and security invariants that are the real call-graph seams.

Verified-stale comments found at six sites mismatch live schema (deterministic floor says P1-P9 but DET_CHECKS runs P1-P11; llm/ Anthropic constraints marked as relics; four keys omitted from documented key map).

~13 new ADRs consolidate 4–8 identical argument blocks currently restated across sites, with the largest unifying the idempotent-transform fit-then-normalize pattern warning against order-swap regressions.

Six shards completed in dependency order (changes 1542-1547) measuring actual recovered lines as outputs, not targets; net recovery of ~85 lines after correction/relocation work; all do_not_move lists recorded to .joe-janitor/tools.md before landing; ADRs 0062-0069 committed before any citing comment collapsed.
